compile.nuance: Response text is explicitly labeled '(Best Practice)' -- a lender-internal QC rubric for reconciling an AVM value against an existing appraisal in file. Guide-wide grep for 'AVM'/'automated valuation model' returns only B7-1-01 (value source for LTV on refinance loans) and B5-5_1-03 (a specific community-seconds program); neither addresses reconciling AVM vs. appraisal value. compile.nuance: Requirement text ('promptly upon completion... at no additional cost'; 3 business days before closing) is the ECOA/Regulation B Valuations Rule (12 CFR 1002.14), a federal consumer-protection requirement, not a Fannie Mae Selling Guide provision. Exhaustive grep of all 390 guide/sections/*.txt for 'copy of the appraisal', 'promptly upon completion', 'ECOA', 'Regulation B', 'valuations rule' returns zero hits. Flagged via the zero-citation escape hatch though the true source is federal regulation, not lender policy.
